```{python}
#| label: fig-nmos-drain-sweep
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Cross section of an NMOS transistor in inversion for increasing drain voltage: (a) triode region, where the inversion layer extends from source to drain, and (b) saturation, where the channel is pinched off at the drain side."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil.mosfig import draw_nmos

panels = [
    ('triode', r'$V_\mathrm{G} > V_\mathrm{th}$',
     r'$0 < V_\mathrm{D} < V_\mathrm{GS} - V_\mathrm{th}$', '(a)'),
    ('saturation', r'$V_\mathrm{G} > V_\mathrm{th}$',
     r'$V_\mathrm{D} > V_\mathrm{GS} - V_\mathrm{th}$', '(b)'),
]

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(8, 6))
for ax, (state, vg, vd, tag) in zip(axs.flat, panels):
    draw_nmos(ax, state, vg, vd)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 6.1)
    ax.text(-1.2, 5.9, tag, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
